newsitem.title: USA: BFGoodrich unit, Vanguard in maintenance pact.
newsitem.headline: BFGoodrich unit, Vanguard in maintenance pact.

text.p: BFGoodrich Aerospace, a unit of BFGoodrich Co, said its maintenance subsidiary had entered into an agreement with Vanguard Airlines.

The company said in a statement late on Thursday that the pact between the aerospace unit's Transport Repair and Maintenance Division and Vanguard called for maintenance work on eight Boeing 737s, with one aircraft to be overhauled in December.
The remainder will be done from February through April 1997. Financial terms were not announced.
